name: @hydra/dsh-fleet-schedule
description: Prototype: API-based heartbeat management — agents create/update/delete/pause/resume/run heartbeats via tools; a 1s tick delivers each due schedule's prompt to its target agent via ctx.fleet.sendMessage (surfacing as a follow-up turn). Registers ctx.fleetSchedule + emits fleet/schedule-created / fleet/schedule-executed / fleet/schedule-deleted events. Requirement: fleet-schedule system (V3).
